cases.name: restricted-config
cases.assert: no shell sourcing; exact registered fields and selected UUIDs

cases.name: root-home-fds
cases.assert: root FD5 and home FD6 remain open through each native operation; UUID and disk sequence match the same session

cases.name: device-replacement
cases.expect: changed UUID/disk generation refuses before mutation

cases.name: native-fd-unavailable
cases.expect: read-only native descriptor compatibility probes fail before keyslot operations

cases.name: secrets
cases.assert: passphrases use bounded memfds/private credentials, never argv or diagnostics

cases.name: timeout
cases.expect: pin child before session validation; bounded TERM/KILL and final wait; no numeric PID fallback

cases.name: mutation-uncertainty
cases.expect: retain intent and private RAM workspace; return 76; phase and reenroll refuse automatic retry

cases.name: recovery
cases.assert: hold the same enrollment lock; confirm a changed generation; verify unchanged metadata or operation postconditions and recovery/PIN without mutating keyslots

cases.name: reboot-confirmation
cases.assert: release remains pending until evidence, TPM/PIN and recovery validation in a separate boot

cases.name: ownership
cases.assert: mutation child inherits the enrollment lock; cleanup never races retained uncertain work
